divergent_sites.reason: Raw text comparison is format-dependent and excludes rows exactly at the cutoff.
Datetime normalization and inclusive >= semantics can classify rows differently from the raw strict comparison.

implementation_sites.summary: RAW_RECENT_QUERY filters with a raw created_at > datetime('now', '-1 day') comparison.
NORMALIZED_RECENT_QUERY applies datetime(created_at) and uses an inclusive >= cutoff.

findings.shared_helper_shape: One canonical recent-query owner in recent_queries.py should define timestamp normalization and the boundary operator; consumers should reference it instead of separate SQL constants.
